BREAKING — Jai Garner was arrested Tuesday afternoon, October 20, 2026, at 2:00 p.m., on a felony criminal mischief charge, according to Webb County booking records.

Garner was booked into the Webb County Jail on one count of criminal mischief involving pecuniary loss of $2,500 to under $30,000 (charge code CRIMINAL MISCHIEF ≥$2,500<$30K) — a state jail felony under Texas law. Bond was set at $5,000.

A state jail felony in Texas is punishable by 180 days to two years in a state jail facility and a fine of up to $10,000. The records reviewed by Webb Watch 956 do not describe the alleged damage or where it allegedly occurred, and the booking record does not list an arresting agency — the holding-agency field was blank.

Webb Watch 956 will follow this case as it moves through the Webb County courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Jai Garner is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
